item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**, the advanced air sealing upgrade:

- **Applies to:** Homes with existing infiltration rates **≥6 ACH50**; homes below 6 ACH50 are excluded.
- **Seals them to:** **5 ACH50**—five air changes per hour at a 50-pascal pressure difference.
- **Covers:** Approximately **92% of existing dwelling units** in the modeled stock.

Sources: [release README](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/README_resstock_20251.pdf) and [measure documentation](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96281.pdf).
